articles.title: Enforcement Directorate and Police Target Major Cyber Crime Networks Across India
articles.summary: Indian law enforcement agencies disrupted major cyber crime networks on October eighteenth, two thousand twenty six. The Enforcement Directorate investigated money laundering linked to online betting platforms across multiple cities. Meanwhile, police arrested suspects in connection with artificial intelligence hoax threats in Kerala and financial fraud involving mule accounts in Jaipur, highlighting growing national security and digital payment challenges.

articles.title: 15 devotees crushed to death after truck crashes through Gwalior temple wall
articles.summary: At least 15 people were killed, and 24 others were injured after a truck loaded with paddy broke through police barricades and ploughed into devotees heading to the Sheetla Mata temple in Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior early Sunday. articles.title: Mizoram’s Hnahsin Kut ends: Cosmos festival in Champhai logs 22.5 million social reach

articles.title: Sikkim CM Prem Singh Tamang mourns Kolkata stampede victims, extends condolences
articles.summary: Sikkim Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang expressed grief over the stampede-like incident at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata, which claimed 19 lives, and extended his condolences to the families of the deceased. articles.title: Why India needs high-performance PCs to build smarter educational technology
articles.summary: Imagine Virat Kohli walking out to a packed stadium. The lights are on, and millions are watching. articles.title: Prime Minister Modi Faces Pressures Over Democracy and Minority Rights

articles.title: Indian Left struggles electorally despite strong appeal among younger generations
articles.summary: Mainstream communist parties in India face severe electoral decline and a generational divide. While young student leaders draw large crowds through grassroots movements, the broader Left ecosystem struggles with rigid structures, centralized power, and governance challenges. For the first time in decades, no state is governed by the Left, raising questions about its future relevance.

articles.title: Researchers used drone LiDAR to scan rugged Australian bushland that is difficult
articles.summary: Researchers have used drone-based laser scanning to identify and document three previously unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in Australia's Blue Mountains, revealing traces of cultural heritage in rugged bushland that is difficult to explore on foot. According to the Australian Museum, the research team worked with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation to identify potential sites using LiDAR technology.

articles.title: At least 17 killed in stampede at religious gathering in India
articles.summary: A “stampede” during a Hindu religious festival in eastern India has killed at least 17 people and injured 25, officials said. A seven-year-old girl was among the fatalities in Saturday’s disaster in north Kolkata in West Bengal, the state’s Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari told reporters. “Six bodies have so far been identified,” Adhikari said.

articles.title: Police secure over fifty convictions in crimes against women in Uttar Pradesh
articles.summary: During 2026, police in Lakhimpur Kheri secured convictions in more than fifty cases involving crimes against women and girls. Authorities also traced and reunited one thousand one hundred forty-five missing females with their families. The efforts were part of the state government campaigns known as Mission Shakti and Operation Conviction to improve safety and deliver swift justice.

articles.title: Thane Police Investigate Online Chats of Teens Accused of Murdering Friend
articles.summary: Thane police are retrieving digital conversations between two teenagers accused of killing their seventeen-year-old friend last month. articles.title_hi: भारत में रजोनिवृत्ति देखभाल अंतराल पर डॉ. तनया नरेंद्र
articles.summary_hi: यह वह संख्या है जो अपने आप में एक शीर्षक बनने लायक है: औसत भारतीय महिला 45 या 46 में रजोनिवृत्ति तक पहुंचती है। विश्व स्तर पर, औसत 51 है। पांच साल ज्यादा नहीं लग सकते हैं, जब तक आपको यह पता नहीं चलता कि कितनी महिलाएं इतनी जल्दी रजोनिवृत्ति के लिए तैयार नहीं हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata men rajonivritti dekhabhala antarala para do. tanaya narendra
articles.summary_hinglish: yaha vaha sankhya hai jo apane aapa men eka shirshaka banane layaka hai: ausata bharatiya mahila 45 ya 46 men rajonivritti taka pahunchati hai। vishva stara par, ausata 51 hai। pancha sala jyada nahin laga sakate hain, jaba taka aapako yaha pata nahin chalata ki kitani mahilaen itani jaldi rajonivritti ke lie taiyara nahin hain।
